import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

# Get Data Schema Tool

This tool returns the schema — tables, columns, and sample values — for a data product. Agents use it to understand what data is available before doing heavier work such as running queries.

## When to use it

Add this tool to a querying agent so it can discover the data product's structure first, then write accurate SQL. It pairs naturally with the [SQL Execution Tool](/agent-studio-docs/build/tools/sql-execution-tool).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type | Suggested scope | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data_product_id` | Yes | string | User input | The data product to inspect. |
| `query` | No | string | Agent determined | A search phrase to semantically match sample column values, useful for large schemas. |
| `data_product_version` | No | string | Fixed or User input | A specific version of the data product. |
| `pre_exec_sql` | No | string | Fixed | SQL to run before sampling tables, e.g. to set session context. |
| `auth_id` | No | string | Fixed or User input | The authentication credentials to use. |
| `auth_mode` | No | string | Fixed | Set to `datasource_service_account` to let schema lookups use an admin-configured shared service account when the user has no credentials of their own. Requires the service account feature. |
| `allow_fallback_auth` | No | boolean | Fixed | When `true`, falls back to the data source's default credentials if the user has none. |

<Aside type="note">
See [Configuring tool parameters](/agent-studio-docs/build/tools/configuring-tools/#configuring-tool-parameters) for what the scope column means.
</Aside>

<Aside type="tip">
Configure `auth_mode` the same way on this tool and the SQL Execution tool so schema lookups and queries resolve credentials consistently. See [Credentials for data product queries](/agent-studio-docs/build/tools/credentials-for-data-product-queries/).
</Aside>

## Example usage

```jsonc
{
  "data_product_id": "my-data-product",
  "query": "customer email"
}
```

## Output

Metadata and sample column values for the tables in the data product.
